requestRewriteRules.title: Request Rewrite Rules
requestRewriteRules.description: Rewrite request field values per model, before requests are routed.
requestRewriteRules.fields.name: Name
requestRewriteRules.fields.modelPatternH: Exact model name or regex, matched against the model name exactly as the client sends it. Example: gpt-4o or gpt-.*
requestRewriteRules.fields.fieldMapsHint: Each field defines which value gets replaced with which value. The first matching value wins; a value with no match is left unchanged.
requestRewriteRules.fields.valueMapsHint: The current value may be empty to match an absent field. The new value may be empty to remove the field.
requestRewriteRules.validation.fieldMaps: At least one field mapping is required
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.create.title: Create request rewrite rule
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.create.descr: Define the model this rule applies to, and which field values to rewrite.
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.edit.title: Edit request rewrite rule
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.edit.descrip: Update the model pattern and field mappings.
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.delete.title: Delete request rewrite rule
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.delete.descr: Delete rule "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
requestRewriteRules.dialogs.bulkDelete.d: Delete {{count}} selected rules? This cannot be undone.
requestRewriteRules.howItWorks.title: How It Works
requestRewriteRules.howItWorks.descripti: Rewrite rules are the first gate a client request passes through: the original request body is rewritten right when it arrives, before model mapping, model access checks, and channel selection. Model patterns match the model name exactly as the client sent it. This is a rewrite of the raw client request, decoupled from all of AxonHub's downstream routing logic — unless a rule rewrites the model field itself.
